purpose: Second measurement, on prompts no model output has been seen for and with one model family the compiler was never tried on: can small text-only LLMs write VL from the one-page reference, and does the tool's feedback let them repair their programs?
notes: The compiler and the reference were changed after run 1 using run 1's transcripts. Run 1's prompts are therefore not reused here.
llama3.2:3b is new in this run: no output of that model was seen while the language was being changed.
The three prompts were fixed before any model saw them. None resembles the worked example in the reference.

prompts.text: Three billiard balls - one red, one yellow, one black - lying next to each other on a table covered with green cloth, lit by a single lamp hanging above the table. The room is dark.
A white bowl holding four oranges, standing on a kitchen counter, with a drinking glass beside it, in morning sunlight.
A street at dusk: a grey road, a row of four street lamps along one side (each a tall thin pole with a glowing ball on top) and a red car made of two boxes with four dark wheels.
